svg.aria-label: About me. I love building open source tools and trying out new tech. These days I'm mostly into self-hosting and trying the shiny new frontier model of the month. Stack. Proficient: Python, Java, TypeScript, Vue. Familiar: C#, Next.js, Kotlin. Currently checking out: Gemini 4 Neon, T3 Code, Fable 5.2. Recent contributions. Merged pull request to KaspianDev/AntiPopup (#141): 13.3 - Support for 26.3, October 2026. Merged pull request to PaperMC/Paper (#13868): Fix username duplication in chat when defaultRenderer is explicitly set, October 2026. Merged pull request to jellyfin/jellyfin-android (#2139): Remove custom device profile for web player, August 2026. Merged pull request to garethgeorge/backrest (#1250): Support for --insecure-no-password flag, June 2026.
